text: あいての　ポケモンに　おおきなダメージが　あたえられる　わざが　だせるか？

structure.jp: あいての　ポケモンに
おおきなダメージが　あたえられる

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: られる on a verb can mean 'can do'; the thing you can do often takes が in place of を. ダメージが　あたえられる = 'can deal damage'. だせる further on is the same idea in its short form, 'can put out'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: あたえられる　わざ
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb put right before a thing describes that thing, like 'that' in English. あたえられる　わざ = 'a move that can deal it'.
